definitions.explanation: An elastic polymer made artificially from petrochemicals, used as a substitute or supplement for natural rubber. Comes in many varieties (SBR, nitrile, silicone, etc.) tailored to different heat, oil, or weather requirements.

examples.english: This hose is made of synthetic rubber.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧ (synthesis, artificial combination) and ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ (rubber, from Dutch {gom}).

USAGE:
- Used as a material noun, most often in attributive form with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {合成|ごうせい}ゴム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧.
- Regularly contrasted with ⟦{天然|てんねん}ゴム→天然ゴム：23700_tennengomu⟧ (natural rubber). In industry, the two are often mixed in a single product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合成|ごうせい}ゴム⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of synthetic rubber
- {合成|ごうせい}ゴム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧: synthetic rubber tire
- {合成|ごうせい}ゴム⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧: the synthetic rubber industry
- {合成|ごうせい}ゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use synthetic rubber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}ゴム→天然ゴム：23700_tennengomu⟧: natural rubber — derived from rubber tree latex
- エラストマー: elastomer — a broader technical term for any rubber-like elastic polymer
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧: plastic — a different class of synthetic polymer, generally less elastic
